idea: An interactive calculator to determine the Glucose Ketone Index (GKI) with automatic glucose unit conversion (mg/dL to mmol/L) and integrated diagnostic insights.

data_specification.data_structure: A dashboard with three key sections: Input Panel, Calculation Result, and Insights Panel.

mapping.gki_score: Position on a colored spectrum scale (Red/High GKI to Green/Low GKI).
mapping.insight_text: Content is dynamically selected from a lookup table based on the GKI score.

interactivity: Changing the glucose unit triggers automatic conversion and updates the input field and the GKI calculation.
Clicking 'Calculate GKI' updates the derived values, repositions the marker on the GKI scale, and refreshes the Insights Panel.
animation: Smooth movement of the GKI marker on the scale.
Subtle fade-in transition for new insight text.
